items.raw_excerpt: A site swap between a village school and a playing field might be a solution for the former, which needs rebuilding.
items.summary_en: A small village school in Yorkshire needs rebuilding. It may swap sites with the public playing field. The swap could be the solution for the school.
items.summary_ko: 요크셔의 작은 마을 학교가 재건축이 필요해졌습니다. 학교는 마을 공터와 부지를 맞바꾸는 방안을 검토하고 있습니다. 이 교환이 학교 재건의 해결책이 될 수 있습니다.
items.title_en: Village school and playing field may swap sites for rebuild
items.title_ko: 요크셔 마을 학교와 공터, 부지 교환으로 재건 추진
items.title_original: Yorkshire village school and public playing field could ‘site swap’ for rebuild - Yorkshire Post

items.raw_excerpt: With temperatures rising across Germany recently, you've probably seen a lot more pesky wasps, fruit flies and mosquitos. Here's what you can do to keep them at bay.
items.summary_en: It is hot in Germany these days. More wasps, fruit flies, and mosquitoes are showing up. Here are simple ways to keep them away from your home.
items.summary_ko: 요즘 독일은 날이 더워지면서 말벌과 과일파리, 모기가 부쩍 늘었습니다. 집 안에서 이 곤충들을 쫓아낼 수 있는 간단한 방법을 소개합니다.
items.title_en: German summer: How to deal with wasps, fruit flies and mosquitoes
items.title_ko: 독일 여름, 말벌과 과일파리, 모기 퇴치법
items.title_original: German summer: How to deal with wasps, fruit flies and mosquitos

items.raw_excerpt: Tapas are an intrinsic part of Spanish eating culture, consisting of small plates of food shared with friends or family along with drinks. There are some fascinating theories about how this typically Spanish way of dining came to be.
items.summary_en: Tapas are small plates of food shared with friends or family along with drinks. They are an important part of Spanish eating culture. There are interesting theories about how this way of dining came to be.
items.summary_ko: 타파스는 친구나 가족과 음료와 함께 나누어 먹는 작은 요리입니다. 스페인 식문화에서 빼놓을 수 없는 자리를 차지하고 있죠. 이 독특한 식사 방식이 어떻게 생겨났는지에 관한 재미있는 설들이 있습니다.
items.title_en: What are the origins of Spain's tapas food culture?
items.title_original: What are the origins of Spain's tapas food culture?

items.raw_excerpt: Kuruvai paddy coverage in Tamil Nadu's Cauvery delta declines by over one lakh acres due to significant water shortages.
items.summary_en: Farmers in Tamil Nadu's Cauvery delta planted far less of the short-term rice crop known as kuruvai this year. The planted area fell by over 100,000 acres because of severe water shortage.
items.summary_ko: 타밀나두 주 카베리 삼각주에서 물이 크게 부족해 올해 쿠루바이(단기 재배 벼) 심는 면적이 10만 에이커 이상 줄었습니다. 농민들의 재배 면적이 크게 감소한 것입니다.
items.title_en: Short-term rice planting in Tamil Nadu's Cauvery delta falls by over 100,000 acres
items.title_ko: 타밀나두 카베리 삼각주, 물 부족으로 단기 벼 재배 10만 에이커 줄어
items.title_original: Kuruvai coverage in Tamil Nadu’s Cauvery delta is down by over one lakh acres due to water shortage

items.raw_excerpt: Jodie says she spent a year sleeping on sofas and floors after fleeing home with two bin bags.
items.summary_en: Jodie fled her home with only two bin bags. She took her daughter's clothes and dolls. She spent a year sleeping on sofas and floors.
items.summary_ko: 조디는 쓰레기 봉투 두 개만 들고 집을 나섰습니다. 딸의 옷과 인형만 챙겼습니다. 그 뒤로 일 년 동안 소파와 바닥에서 잠을 잤습니다.
items.title_en: We had to flee with just my daughter's clothes and dolls
items.title_ko: 딸 옷과 인형만 들고 집을 나서야 했어요
items.title_original: 'We had to flee with just my daughter's clothes and dolls'

items.raw_excerpt: Guntur Collector urges UPSC aspirants to pursue public service for the right reasons, emphasizing dedication and disciplined preparation.
items.summary_en: A district official in Guntur spoke to UPSC exam aspirants. He said they should enter public service for the right reasons. He also stressed hard work and steady preparation.
items.summary_ko: 군투르 지역 행정관이 공무원 시험 준비생들에게 연설했다. 그는 올바른 이유로 공직 생활을 시작해야 한다고 말했다. 또한 헌신과 꾸준한 준비를 강조했다.
items.title_en: Guntur official urges UPSC aspirants to serve for the right reasons
items.title_ko: 군투르 행정관, 공무원 시험 준비생에게 올바른 이유로 공직을 쫓으라고 조언
items.title_original: Pursue public services for right reasons, Guntur Collector tells UPSC aspirants

items.raw_excerpt: Cette ville qui fait partie des "Plus beaux détours de France" est parfaite pour une halte reposante sur la route des vacances.
items.summary_en: This small town is one of the 'Plus beaux détours de France', a list of pretty French towns worth a stop. The Michelin Guide put it on this list. It is a perfect place for a restful stop on your vacation route.
items.summary_ko: 이 작은 마을은 '프랑스에서 가장 아름다운 들러 볼 곳' 가운데 하나로 꼽힌다. 미슐랭 가이드가 이 마을을 그 목록에 넣었다. 휴가길에 잠시 머물며 쉬어 가기에 딱 좋은 곳이다.
items.title_en: A small town near Lyon is named one of the 'Most Beautiful Detours' of France by the Michelin Guide.
